### 更新内容

- SSH 主机支持一次性验证码（TOTP）：在「编辑主机 → 高级选项」里填 `otpauth://` 地址或 base32 密钥，也可以直接扫描、粘贴二维码图片；登录时客户端本地生成验证码自动应答，不用再手输，行内会显示当前验证码与剩余秒数。密钥随连接一起加密保存，只在本机生成、不联网。
- SSH 会话内自动填入 `su` / `sudo` 密码：执行提权命令被要求输入密码时自动提交，默认跟随登

- Database views: the SQL editor scrollbar stays visible, the table designer shows column defaults inline and allows editing them, and copying as UPDATE/DELETE no longer emits an empty statement when no primary key is selected; Redis no longer fails on keys with invalid UTF-8; opening an already-open connection reuses its tab instead of creating a duplicate.
- The new-connection wizard is back to two steps: pick a category (All / Databases / Domestic databases / Time series / NoSQL / Middleware / Terminal)

### 更新内容

- AI 提供商新增「OpenCode Go」订阅类型，并支持为任意 OpenAI 兼容提供商填写自定义请求头（每行一个 `名称: 值`，可覆盖 User-Agent 等默认请求头）。OpenCode Go 会自动发送稳定的 `x-opencode-session`；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / V4 Pro 需要在 OpenCode Console 选择 Global 区域。
- 连接支持手动拖拽排序：首页与连接树都可以拖动文件夹和连接调整顺序，设置里新增排序方式选项，含「手动排序（

- Migration package import preserves the workspace hierarchy so the parent-child structure of full products is no longer flattened; the settings page is reordered with Database and Terminal first and Account / About last.
- Fixed installed composite extensions not loading in beta builds: SemVer makes pre-release versions fail plain ranges, so beta / dev hosts rejected extension manifests requiring `>=0.16.1`. A pre-release host now falls back to matching the release triple once, restoring the extension mana

- Fixed installed external database drivers not loading in beta builds: a host version carrying a `-beta.N` suffix now also matches requirements such as `>=0.10.0`, so the domestic-database category and driver-provided TDengine / ClickHouse types work again.
- 修复 beta 构建加载不到已安装外部数据库驱动的问题：带 `-beta.N` 的宿主版本现在也能匹配 `>=0.10.0` 这类驱动版本要求，国产数据库类目以及由驱动提供的 TDengine、ClickHouse 类型恢复正常。

- Installed external database drivers (domestic databases and others) are back in the new-connection flow: label, description and icon come from the driver manifest, the connection form carries the driver id, and each product still only offers the connection types it supports.
- The new-connection wizard is back to two steps: pick a category first (All / Databases / Domestic databases / Time series / NoSQL / Middleware / Terminal / Extensions), then a card. Empty categories offer a "More…" entry, the list

- Database views: the SQL editor scrollbar stays visible; the table designer shows column defaults inline and allows editing them; copying as UPDATE/DELETE no longer emits an empty statement when no primary key is selected.
- Redis no longer fails to list, read or delete keys whose names contain invalid UTF-8.
- Navop Data checks database drivers on first launch and can install a missing driver from inside the app.
- 桌面端正式拆成三个产品，同一个版本号一起发：**Navop**（数据库 + S

- "Delete record" in the database grid now deletes the whole selection: right-clicking inside a multi-row selection no longer removes only the first row, while right-clicking outside the selection still deletes a single row.
- SQL Server databases at a lower compatibility level paginate again: below level 110 the grid falls back to `ROW_NUMBER()` paging, so previewing a table no longer shows a blank page.
- SQL Server 低兼容级别的库恢复分页能力：兼容级别低于 110 时回退 `ROW_NUMBER()`

### 修复与优化

- 个人同步：修复引用了钥匙串凭据的连接在多设备间持续产生假冲突的问题。连接载荷里的凭据引用导出时保留了源设备的本地整数 ID，而每台设备的行号各不相同，导致同一条连接跨设备的 checksum 永不相等，被判定为「双方都改过」而反复冲突、来回覆盖。现在导出载荷统一只保留跨设备稳定的 `credential_cloud_id`，整数 ID 置零（下载时仍按云端 ID 映射回本机行号，

- Connection forms: the "AI Access" row in the SSH, MySQL, Redis and MongoDB forms no longer renders as a raw key such as `ConnectionForm.ai_access`. Each of those four crates assembled the i18n key by itself while only the crate that provides the widget defines it, so rust-i18n returned the key verbatim; the row now uses the shared text from `connection_form`, and a repository-wide contract test guards against the same class of miss (16 other broken keys are fixed as well, including the save-failure notice
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/spatie/laravel-db-snapshots/compare/2.10.2...2.10.3

- Prevent streamed PostgreSQL and SQLite snapshots from silently losing rows when string values contain literal backslashes. MySQL/MariaDB backslash escaping is preserved.
- Modernize checkout and SQLite tooling, update PHPUnit configuration, and make styling a read-only PR check.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/spatie/laravel-db-snapshots/compare/2.10.1...2.10.2
